g.text: Retry failed webhook deliveries with backoff
Merchants lose events when their endpoint has a blip: we try
This retries deliveries that fail with a server error, a rate limit or a dropped connection, up to six attempts with capped
Client errors (other 4xx) are still not retried; they won't fix themselves.
records how many tries it took, for the delivery log.
added reviewers Sam Rivera, Chloe Martin, Dev Patel
